description: Source code for a GTK-based dialog class 'ParsingErrorsDialog' used to display parsing errors related to desktop files in MenuLibre. Contains class definitions for the dialog and error row, with methods for UI setup and user interactions.

classes.name: ParsingErrorsDialog
classes.description: A GTK dialog window that displays parsing errors for desktop files, with options to open folders, edit files, or copy locations.

classes.name: ErrorRow
classes.description: A GTK list box row representing a single error item with action buttons for folder, editor, and copy actions.

methods.name: ParsingErrorsDialog.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, sets up UI components, and manages file handler based on demo mode.

methods.name: ParsingErrorsDialog.add_item
methods.description: Adds an error item row to the list box.

methods.name: ParsingErrorsDialog.on_row_action
methods.description: Handles user actions from error rows, invoking file handler methods.

methods.name: ErrorRow.__init__
methods.description: Constructs a row with filename, error message, and action buttons.

methods.name: ErrorRow.emit_action
methods.description: Emits a custom 'action' signal with the specified action and filename.
